title: Expand the function
text: Expanding $$\left(1+x^2\right)^{13}$$ gives a polynomial in which every power of $$x$$ is even.

title: Relate the derivative to a coefficient
text: The 25th derivative at $$0$$ equals the coefficient of $$x^{25}$$ times $$25$$ factorial. There is no $$x^{25}$$ term, so the answer is $$0$$.
